moves.name: Air Cannon
moves.effect: The target is forced to switch out.
moves.source: A gadget cannon worn on the arm.

moves.name: Zafkiel: Zayin
moves.effect: 30% chance the target loses its next turn (time stops for it).
moves.source: The Seventh Bullet, which stops a target in time.

moves.name: Blood Drain Syringe
moves.effect: Heals the user half the damage dealt.
moves.source: Her syringe that collects blood for her Quirk.

moves.name: The Landscape of the End
moves.effect: All foes are Confused and their Will drops by 2.
moves.source: The world he wants to show, where everyone dies.

moves.name: Judgement Cut (Seated)
moves.effect: Goes first. Doesn't even stand up.
moves.source: Vergil cutting without leaving the chair.

moves.name: Dying Will Bullet
moves.effect: Can target an ally: it heals 1/4 and its Power and Speed rise by 1 instead of taking damage.
moves.source: The bullet that makes you live with no regrets.

moves.name: Kamui: Warp
moves.effect: Hits through Protect and Substitute.
moves.source: Pulling the target into his dimension.

moves.name: Ten-Tails: Tailed Beast Bomb
moves.effect: Hits all foes.
moves.source: The Ten-Tails jinchuriki's full blast.

moves.name: Bungee Gum
moves.effect: The target can't switch out and moves last next turn.
moves.source: Aura with the properties of both rubber and gum.

moves.name: Bang
moves.effect: Hits all foes.
moves.source: Pointing her finger like a gun from miles away.

moves.name: Idle Transfiguration
moves.effect: Changes the target's ability to Mutated, which does nothing.
moves.source: Touching the soul and reshaping it.

moves.name: Tengai Shinsei
moves.effect: Hits all foes. A second meteor falls next turn for half damage.
moves.source: Dropping one meteor, then another.

moves.name: Amphitrite
moves.effect: High chance of a critical hit.
moves.source: His trident thrusts against Kojiro Sasaki.

moves.name: Barren Hanging Garden
moves.effect: Hits all foes. 30% chance to Freeze each.
moves.source: His Blood Demon Art: ice bodhisattvas.

moves.name: Cursed Buds
moves.effect: Plants buds: the target loses 1/8 of its max Vitality each turn and Hanami heals that much.
moves.source: Buds that sprout from cursed energy.

moves.name: Raigo
moves.effect: Hits all foes. Charges for one turn first.
moves.source: A thundercloud big enough to erase Skypiea.

moves.name: The Almighty: Rewrite
moves.effect: Heals the user fully and cures its status. The target's stat boosts are removed.
moves.source: Changing the future he sees.

moves.name: Serious Series: Serious Punch
moves.effect: Ignores Protect. Can't be used twice in a row.
moves.source: The punch that split the sky against Boros.

moves.name: Black Hole
moves.effect: Removes the target's stat boosts and turns off its ability for 3 turns.
moves.source: Darkness that swallows everything.

moves.name: Jackal
moves.effect: Hits through Substitute.
moves.source: His giant handgun with explosive silver rounds.

moves.name: Shinra Tensei
moves.effect: Hits all foes and removes screens and hazards on their side.
moves.source: The repulsion that leveled the Hidden Leaf.

moves.name: Collapsing Star Roaring Cannon
moves.effect: The user can't move next turn.
moves.source: The beam that could destroy the Earth.

moves.name: Moon Healing Escalation
moves.effect: Super-effective against Dark and Blood. Heals the user 1/4 of the damage.
moves.source: Her healing attack that purifies enemies.

moves.name: Road Roller Da!
moves.effect: Can't miss during a time stop.
moves.source: Dropping a steamroller on Jotaro.

moves.name: Made in Heaven
moves.effect: Raises the user's Speed by 3. All field effects end.
moves.source: Accelerating time until the universe resets.

moves.name: Time Stop Barrage
moves.effect: Goes first. Can't be stopped by Protect.
moves.source: Stopping time and filling the air with ordnance.

moves.name: Arm Cannon
moves.effect: Hits all foes.
moves.source: The heavy cannon built into his arm.

moves.name: Judgement Cut End
moves.effect: Hits all foes. Ignores Protect.
moves.source: Cutting the space around everyone at once.

moves.name: IXA & Narukami
moves.effect: 30% chance to Stun.
moves.source: A Narukami bolt followed by IXA's lance.

moves.name: The Goal of All Life Is Death
moves.effect: All foes are knocked out at the end of the third turn unless they switch out.
moves.source: His super-tier spell, cast with the hourglass.

moves.name: Enuma Elish
moves.effect: Hits all foes. Ends any field.
moves.source: Ea, the sword that split heaven and earth.

moves.name: Domain Expansion: Malevolent Shrine
moves.effect: Hits all foes. For 3 turns, foes lose 1/8 of their max Vitality each turn.
moves.source: His domain that cuts everything inside it.

moves.name: Hado #90: Kurohitsugi
moves.effect: Can't be stopped by Protect. 30% chance to Curse.
moves.source: The black coffin, cast without the chant.

moves.name: Black Blood Whips
moves.effect: Hits all foes. 30% chance to Bleed.
moves.source: Whip arms full of his blood.

moves.name: Death Beam
moves.effect: Goes first. High chance of a critical hit.
moves.source: A fingertip beam that kills before you see it.

moves.name: Boro Breath
moves.effect: Hits all foes. 30% chance to Burn.
moves.source: His dragon-form heat breath.

moves.name: Gura Gura no Mi: Quake Punch
moves.effect: Hits all foes. Lowers their Guard by 1.
moves.source: Cracking the air itself with his fist.

moves.name: Decay
moves.effect: Hits all foes. Lowers their Guard by 2.
moves.source: Touching the ground and decaying a whole city.
